harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: (إلا ما يتلى عليكم غير محلي الصيد) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «ما» is a relative noun, excepted; «غير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «لكم»; «محلي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the yāʾ. The clause «وأنتم حرم» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «لكم».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: His saying «آمِّين» is a noun conjoined to «القلائد» with a muḍāf omitted, i.e.: nor fighting those heading for [the House], and «البيت» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «آمِّين». The clause «يبتغون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «آمِّين», in the position of the accusative. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن صدُّوكم» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām, and the maṣdar «أن تعتدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition («على»). The clause «وإذا حللتم فاصطادوا» is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا تُحِلُّوا﴾ and has no grammatical position. The clause «وتعاونوا» is conjoined to the preceding reply to the vocative. The clause «واتقوا الله» is conjoined to the clause «ولا تعاونوا». The clause «إن الله شديد العقاب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «إلا» is a particle of exception, and «ما» is a relative, a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ). His saying «وما»: a relative noun conjoined to «ما أكل», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تستقسموا» is conjoined to «ما ذبح». The clause «ذلكم فسق» is resumptive. The clause «فلا تخشوهم» is resumptive. His saying «واخشون»: the wāw is a conjunction, [the verb is] an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is the object of the verb. The clause «أكملت» is resumptive. His saying «ديناً»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الإسلام», accusative. «فمن اضطرّ»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun «في مخمصة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the latent pronoun in «اضطرّ». «غير متجانف»: a ḥāl of the pronoun in «اضطرّ», and «متجانف» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun «لإثم» is attached to «متجانِف», which is an active participle from a verb of more than three radicals: «تجانَفَ».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, khabar (predicate). The clause «ماذا أحلّ» is the second object of the asking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, because asking is a means to knowledge. His saying «وما علّمتم»: a relative noun conjoined to «الطيّبات», and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الجوارح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied resumptive pronoun, i.e.: you taught it, being of the hunting animals. «مكلّبين»: a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «علّمتم», and the clause «تُعلّمونهن» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «علّمتم». The clause «فكلوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The adverb «اليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحلّ». The clause «وطعام الذين..حل» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «أحلَّ لكم الطيّبات». His saying «والمحصنات من المؤمنات»: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: lawful; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المحصنات», and the second «المحصنات» is conjoined to the first. His saying «حلٌّ»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of «الحَلال» (lawful); for that reason it is not made feminine, dual or plural. «إذا آتيتموهن»: «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to «أحلّ», and «محصنين غير» are two ḥāls of the fāʿil (agent) of «آتيتم». «متخذي» is a noun conjoined to «مسافحين». The preposition and its genitive noun «في الآخرة» is attached to «الخاسرين», and the clause «وهو من الخاسرين» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t:
- {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ وَامْسَحُوا بِرُءُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ جُنُبًا فَاطَّهَّرُوا وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَى أَوْ عَلَى سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ مِنْهُ مَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيَجْعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ حَرَجٍ وَلَكِنْ يُرِيدُ لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ وَلِيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ}
The conditional clause «إذا قمتم..» is resumptive, the reply to the vocative. His saying «وأرجلكم» is a noun conjoined to «أيديكم». The preposition and its genitive noun «أو على سفر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted item conjoined to «مرضى», i.e.: or being on a journey; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أحد»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الغائط» is attached to «جاء». The first object of «يريد» is omitted, i.e.: hardship, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليجعل» is genitive, attached to «يريد». «حرج» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida) because it enters upon an indefinite noun and is preceded by a negation. The second object of «يريد» is omitted, i.e.: ease; the clause «ولكن يريد» is conjoined to the clause «يريد»; and the clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «إذ قلتم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «واثقكم», and the clause «قلتم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «إن الله عليم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قوَّامين», and His saying «شهداء» is a second khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «بالقسط» is attached to «شهداء». The clause «ولا يجرمنّكم» is conjoined to the clause «كونوا» and has no grammatical position. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا تعدلوا» is genitive by «على», attached to «يجرمنّكم». The clause «هو أقرب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «لهم مغفرة» explains the second object of «وعد», the implied form being: He promised them Paradise; it is a case of explaining the effect by its cause, for Paradise is caused by forgiveness and reward.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «والذين كفروا..» is conjoined to the preceding clause ﴿وَعَدَ﴾. The clause «أولئك أصحاب» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: His saying «إذ همَّ قوم»: an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «نعمة». The clause «همَّ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of the genitive, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبسطوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The fāʾ in «فليتوكل» is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause «وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «ولقد أخذ الله» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد أخذ» is the reply to an implied oath. His saying «اثني عشر»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the yāʾ because it is treated like the dual; «عشر» is a part indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa with no grammatical position; «نقيباً» is tamyīz (specification). The clause «لئن أقمتم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «لأكفرن» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «كفر», and His saying «سواء» is an adverb of place meaning «وسط» (middle).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: (فبما نقضهم ميثاقهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive, «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لعنّاهم»; «ميثاقهم» is the object of the breaking; the two objects of «جعلنا» are «قلوبهم قاسية»; the clause «يحرفون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «لعنّاهم»; the clause «نسوا» is conjoined to «يحرفون»; the clause «لا تزال» is conjoined to «ذُكِّروا»; the clause «تطلع» is the khabar (predicate) of «زال», in the position of the accusative; and the clause «فاعف» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أخذنا», and the clause «أخذنا» is conjoined to the clause ﴿أَخَذَ﴾ in verse (12); the preposition and its genitive noun «ممَّا» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «حظا», and the preposition and its genitive noun «إلى يوم» is attached to «أغرينا». The clause «وسوف ينبئهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «يبين» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of «رسولنا». His saying «كثيراً» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرا». The clause «قد جاءكم نور» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «يهدي» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب», in the position of the nominative. His saying «رضوانه» is the object of «اتبع». «سبل» is the second object of «يهدي». The preposition and its genitive noun «بإذنه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «يخرجهم».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. His saying «قل فمن يملك»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if He willed, then who would have power? The clause «إن أراد» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, what precedes indicating it; and the two clauses «ولله ملك» and «يخلق» are resumptive. The adverb «بينهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), i.e.: is settled. The clause «والله على كل شيء قدير» is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun «على كل» is attached to «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «قل فلمَ»: the fāʾ links to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if your saying is correct, then why?; the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعذّبكم», its alif having been dropped because it is preceded by the preposition. The preposition and its genitive noun «ممن خلق» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «بشر», and the clause «يغفر» is resumptive. The clause «ولله ملك» is conjoined to the clause «يغفر», and the clause «وإليه المصير» is conjoined to the clause «ولله ملك».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «يبين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «رسولنا», in the position of the accusative; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الرسل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فترة»; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقولوا» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: out of dislike that. His saying «من بشير»: fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «فقد جاءكم بشير» is conjoined to the clause «جاءكم رسولنا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: (وإذ قال موسى لقومه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, object of an implied «اذكر» (remember); and the preposition and its genitive noun «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نعمة». His saying «إذ جعل فيكم»: an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of «نعمة», and the clause «جعل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The two objects of «آتاكم» are the kāf and the relative «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «يا قومِ»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, which is dropped for lightness. His saying «فتنقلبوا خاسرين»: the fāʾ is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن» necessarily concealed after the fāʾ; the maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, the implied form being: let there be no turning back from you, and so a turning about; and «خاسرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تنقلبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «فإن يخرجوا» is conjoined to the clause «إنّا لن ندخلها», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الذين يخافون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رجلان»; the clause «أنعم الله» is a second adjective (ṣifa) of «رجلان», in the position of the nominative; the clause «فإذا دخلتموه» is conjoined to the clause «ادخلوا», in the position of the accusative; the clause «توكلوا» is resumptive, and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: His saying «أبداً ما داموا فيها»: [«أبداً» is] an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ندخلها»; «ما» is temporal maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is an adverb of time attached to «ندخلها», and it is a badal (substitute) of «أبداً». The clause «داموا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī). The clause «فاذهب» is resumptive. His saying «أنت»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in «اذهب». His saying «وربّك»: a noun conjoined to the latent pronoun in «اذهب»; conjoining an overt noun to the latent nominative [pronoun] is permitted because of the presence of a separator. His saying «هاهنا»: «ها» is for drawing attention, and «هنا» is a demonstrative, an adverb of place attached to «قاعدون»; and the clause «إنا قاعدون» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «فافرق» is conjoined to the clause «إنِّي لا أملك» and has no grammatical position; conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) clause to an informative (khabar) one is permitted.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His saying «قال فإنها محرمة»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if the matter is so, then it [is forbidden]; and the preposition and its genitive noun «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محرمة». «أربعين» is an adverb of time, accusative by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, attached to «محرمة». The clause «يتيهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «عليهم». The clause «فلا تأس» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اتل», i.e.: bound up with the truth. His saying «إذ قرّبا»: a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «نبأ», and the clause «قرّبا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «لأقتلنَّك» is the reply to an implied oath, and the oath with its reply is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. The last clause «قال» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: His saying «ما أنا بباسط»: «ما» is negating, operating like «ليس»; «بباسط» is its khabar (predicate), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); «يدي» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «باسط»; and the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. The clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «كيف يواري» is the second object of the visual seeing, which is suspended (muʿallaq), the verb «رأى» having acquired a second object through the hamza. «يا ويلتا»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ that has been turned into an alif, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl). The interpreted maṣdar «أن أكون» is accusative by removal of the preposition («عن»). The clause «أعجزت» is resumptive within the scope of the reply to the vocative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنه من قتل» is the object of «كتب». The conditional clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «أنَّ». His saying «فكأنما»: the fāʾ is linking, and [«كأنما» is] a restraining particle and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa) with no grammatical position. His saying «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «ولقد جاءتهم رسلنا» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد جاءتهم» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. His saying «ثمَّ إنَّ كثيرًا منهم»: «ثمَّ» is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرًا». The adverb «بعد» and the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» are attached to «مسرفون», the khabar, and [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «فسادًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), interpreted as «مفسدين» (corrupting), because «فسادًا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun), and a maṣdar does not occur as a ḥāl except by interpretation. The preposition and its genitive noun «من خلاف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «أيديهم وأرجلهم». «ذلك لهم خزي»: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «لهم خزي» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition and its genitive noun «في الدنيا» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «خزي», and the preposition and its genitive noun «في الآخرة» is attached to a ḥāl of «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقدروا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «فاعلموا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «لو»: a non-jussive conditional particle; «أنَّ» is an abrogating particle (nāsikha), the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت» (it were established). «ما» is the noun of «أنَّ», the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» is attached to the ṣila (relative clause), and His saying «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent pronoun in the implied ṣila. The conditional clause is the khabar of «إن». His saying «معه»: an adverb attached to a ḥāl of «مثله». His saying «تُقُبِّل منهم»: an imperfect verb, passive, and the preposition and its genitive noun is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). [Translator's note: so in the source; «تُقُبِّل» is a past-tense form.] The clause «ولهم عذاب أليم» is conjoined to the conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: His saying «وما هم بخارجين منها»: the wāw is ḥāliyya; «ما» is negating, operating like «ليس»; «هم» is a detached pronoun, its noun; «بخارجين» is its khabar (predicate), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «وما هم بخارجين», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: His saying «فاقطعوا»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). «جزاءً»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). «نكالا»: a badal (substitute) of «جزاءً». The preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نكالا».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله له ملك» is the object of «تعلم». The clause «له ملك» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «أنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الذين قالوا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يسارعون». The clause «ولم تؤمن قلوبهم» is a ḥāl of «الذين». His saying «ومن الذين هادوا»: conjoined to «من الذين قالوا». His saying «سمَّاعون»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: they; and «للكذب» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the lām being redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening because «سمَّاعون» is secondary (farʿ) to the verb. «سمَّاعون لقوم» is a second khabar, and «لقوم» is mafʿūl bihi, the lām being redundant; the clause «لم يأتوك» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «قوم», in the position of the genitive; the clause «يحرفون» is a third naʿt of «قوم»; and the clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يحرِّفون». The clause «لهم في الدنيا خزي» is a second khabar of «أولئك», and the preposition and its genitive noun «في الدنيا» is attached to a ḥāl of «خزي». The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «لهم خزي».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «سمَّاعون» is the khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: they are listeners; and «للكذب» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the lām being redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening. His saying «أكَّالون»: a second khabar of the implied mubtadaʾ, nominative. The clause «فإن جاءوك» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إن الله يحب».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: (وكيف يحكمونك) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive, «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is resumptive. The clause «وعندهم التوراة» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «يحكمونك», and the clause «فيها حكم الله» is a ḥāl of «التوراة». The clause «وما أولئك بالمؤمنين» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «يتولَّون».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «فيها هدى ونور» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of «التوراة». The clause «يحكم بها النبيَّون» is a second ḥāl of «التوراة». The clause «وكانوا عليه» is conjoined to the clause «استحفظوا». His saying «واخشون»: the wāw is a conjunction, the verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is the object of the verb; and the clause «ومن لم يحكم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن النفس بالنفس» is the object of «كتب». In His saying «والعين بالعين», the wāw conjoins two nouns to two nouns: «العين» is conjoined to «النفس», and «بالعين» is conjoined to «بالنفس». «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: His saying «مصدقا لما بين يديه»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عيسى»; the relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle, the lām is redundant (zāʾida), and the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The preposition and its genitive noun «من التوراة» is attached to a ḥāl of «ما». The clause «فيه هدى» is a ḥāl of «الإنجيل», and His saying «ومصدقا» is conjoined to the position of the clause «فيه هدى», accusative; His saying «وهدى وموعظة»: two nouns conjoined to the second «مصدقاً». The preposition and its genitive noun «للمتقين» is attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of «موعظة».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: His saying «وليَحكم»: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is for the imperative, and the verb is jussive (majzūm). The clause «فأولئك هُمُ الفاسقون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive, and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «مصدقا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الكتاب», and it is a second ḥāl, because His saying «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «الكتاب». The preposition and its genitive noun «من الكتاب» is attached to a ḥāl of «ما», and His saying «ومُهيمِنًا عليه»: a noun conjoined to «مصدِّقًا», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «مهيمنًا»; the clause «فاحكم» is conjoined to the clause «أنزلنا». The preposition and its genitive noun «عَمَّا جاءك» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «تَتَّبِعْ», and the preposition and its genitive noun «مِن الحق» is attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun in «جاءك». His saying «لكلٍ جَعلنا منكم شِرْعَةً»: the preposition and its genitive noun «لكل» is attached to «جعلنا», and the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to an implied verb, «أعني» (I mean); it is not attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «لكل», because that would entail separating the adjective from the qualified noun by His saying «جعلنا», which is extraneous. The clause «ولو شاء الله» is conjoined to the clause «جَعلنا», with no grammatical position. His saying «ولكن لِيبلُوَكم»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لكنْ» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), the lām is for causation, and the verb is accusative by «أن» concealed after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to something omitted, i.e.: but He divided you in order to test you; the implied clause «فرَّقكم» is conjoined to the clause «ولو شاء»; the clause «فاستبِقوا» is resumptive; the clause «إلى الله مرجعُكم» is resumptive; and the clause «فينبئُكم» is conjoined to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: (وأن احكم بينهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is a conjunction and «أنْ» is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to ﴿الْكِتَابَ﴾ at the beginning of the previous verse, i.e.: the Book and the ruling. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يَفْتنوك» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of the hāʾ in «احذرْهم», and the maṣdar «أنما يريد» stands in place of the two objects of «عَلِمَ». The maṣdar «أن يصيبهم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وإن كثيرًا مِن الناس لفاسقون» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرًا»; and [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: (أفحكم الجاهلية يبغون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval, the fāʾ is resumptive, and «حُكمَ» is the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يبغون»; His saying «حكمًا» is tamyīz (specification); the clause «يبغون» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ومَن أحسنُ».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «بعضُهم أولياءُ» is parenthetical between the conjoined items, with no grammatical position. The clause «ومَن يَتَوَلَّهُم» is conjoined to the clause «لا تتخذوا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «فترى» is resumptive. The clause «يسارعون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الذين», and the clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يسارعون». «فعسى اللهُ أن يأتيَ»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «عسى» is incomplete (nāqiṣa) [and «الله» is] its noun, and the interpreted maṣdar is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «على ما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نادمين».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «جهد أيمانهم»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is an emphasizing maṣdar (verbal noun) governed in the accusative by «أقسموا», since it is of its meaning; the sense is: they swore a strenuous swearing. The clause «حبطت أعمالُهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: (من يرتد منكم عن دينه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); [«يرتد» is] an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the sukūn, given a fatḥa because of the meeting of two quiescents; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يرتد»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عن دينه» is attached to «يرتد»; and His saying «أذلةٍ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومٍ», genitive. The clause «يجاهدون» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «قوم», in the position of the genitive. The clause «يؤتيه» is a ḥāl, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: «الذين يقيمون»: this relative is a naʿt (adjective) of the preceding relative, and the clause «وهم راكعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative, of the wāw in «يؤتون».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «فإنَّ حزبَ اللهِ همُ الغالبون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive; this is permitted, even though on the surface it lacks a pronoun referring back to the conditional noun, because what is meant by «حزب الله» is in meaning the mubtadaʾ (subject) itself; the implied form is: then he is victorious, so the overt noun has been put in the place of the pronoun.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: His saying «لا تَتخذوا»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), transitive to two objects: «الذين» and «أولياء»; and the verb «اتخذوا» is transitive to two objects: «دينكم» and «هزوا». The preposition and its genitive noun «من الذين أُوتوا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اتخذوا», and the preposition and its genitive noun «مِن قبلكم» is attached to «أوتوا»; the clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: (وإذا ناديتم إلى الصلاة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding ṣila (relative clause) ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾. The clause «ذلك بأنهم قومٌ» is resumptive, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause «لا يعقلون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومٌ».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنْ آمَنَّا» is the object of «نَقِمَ». The maṣdar «وأنَّ أكثرَكم فاسقون» is conjoined to the first maṣdar «أنْ آمنا» with a muḍāf omitted, i.e.: and believing that most of them are defiantly disobedient. [Translator's note: so in the source, "most of them" (أكثرهم), whereas the verse has «أكثركم».]

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: His saying «شَر»: an elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) whose hamza has been dropped for lightness; the preposition and its genitive noun «من ذلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شر», and «مثوبة» is tamyīz (specification). His saying «من لعنه الله»: «مَن» is a relative noun, khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: he is the one whom; the clause «هو من لعنه الله» is resumptive; the clause «وعبَدَ الطَّاغوت» is conjoined to the clause «جعل», and the clause «جعل» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) «لعنه»; and the clause «أولئك شرٌّ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «وقد دخلوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «قالوا», and the preposition and its genitive noun «بالكفر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl of the wāw, i.e.: accompanied by disbelief. The conditional clause «وإذا جاءوكم» is conjoined to the single word «أَضَلُّ», by way of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «كثيرًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرا», and the clause «يسارعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كثيرًا», in the position of the accusative. His saying «لَبِئْسَ ما كانوا»: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; «بئس» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb; «ما» is a relative, fāʿil (agent); and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e.: their deeds. The clause «لبئس ما كانوا» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «لولا يَنْهاهم»: [«لولا» is] a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). His saying «الإثمَ»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun); and the clause of urging is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «غُلَّت أيديهم» is resumptive. His saying «بِمَا قالوا»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لُعِنُوا». His saying «يُنفِقُ كيف يشاء»: «كيف» is a non-jussive conditional noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: He spends; however He wills, He spends; the clause «ينفق» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «يشاء». His saying «وليزيدن كثيرًا منهم ما أُنزلَ إليك مِن ربِّك»: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the reply to an oath, the verb is an imperfect indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the nūn is for emphasis; «كثيرًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرًا». «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «يزيدن», and the two preposition and its genitive nouns are attached to the verb. His saying «طُغيانًا وكفرًا»: the second object, and a noun conjoined to it. His saying «كلما أوقدوا»: «كل» is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to «أطفأها», and «ما» is temporal maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is: Allah extinguished the fire every time of its kindling; the clause «أَوقدوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī), with no grammatical position. The clause «أَطفأَها اللهُ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: His saying «ولو أن أهل الكتاب»: the wāw is resumptive; «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle; [«أن» is] an abrogating particle (nāsikha); and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثَبَتَ» (it were established); the clause «ولو ثبت» is resumptive. The clause «ولأدْخَلْنَاهُم» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the lām occurs in the reply to the preceding «لو» to strengthen the link; and [the verb] is transitive to two objects: the pronoun «هم» and «جنات».

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: His saying «وما أُنزل»: a relative noun conjoined to «الإنجيل». The clause «منهم أمة» is resumptive. His saying «وكثيرٌ منهم»: mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it is qualified; and the khabar (predicate) is the clause «ساء ما». The clause «ولو أنَّهم أقاموا» is conjoined to the clause ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ﴾, and the clause «يعملون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «بَلِّغ» is the reply to the vocative, resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «والله يعصمك» is conjoined to the reply to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقيموا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «ليس». His saying «وليزيدن كثيرًا منهم»: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the reply to an oath, «كثيرًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition and its genitive noun is a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرًا»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «يزيدن»; «طغيانًا» is the second object; and the clause «فلا تَأسَ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: His saying «والصابئون»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted because the khabar of the first indicates it, and it is intended to be placed later; the implied form is: Indeed those who believe … whoever believes …, and the Sabians likewise. His saying «مَن»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause «آمن» is the khabar; and the clause «فلا خوفٌ عليهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «والصابئون كذلك» is conjoined to the resumptive one, with no grammatical position. The conditional clause with its apodosis is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «إنَّ», and the link is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: of them.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «لقد أخذنا» is the answer to the oath. His saying «كلما»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كذَّبوا»; «ما» is temporal maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is: they denied a party every time a messenger came. The clause «كذَّبوا» is resumptive, and His saying «فريقًا» is a fronted object, accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: (وحسبوا ألا تكون فتنة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is a conjunction. «ألا تكونَ»: «أن» is a particle governing the subjunctive, [followed by] a complete verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «حسب», and the clause «حسبوا» is conjoined to the clause ﴿يَقْتُلُونَ﴾. His saying «كثيرٌ»: a badal (substitute) of the wāw in «صمُّوا», and the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرٌ».

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The clause «وقال المسيحُ» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. His saying «إنه من يشرك»: «إنَّ» is an abrogating particle (nāsikha), and the hāʾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), its noun; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يشركْ» is the khabar (predicate) of the conditional noun; the clause «إنَّه مَن يشركْ» is resumptive. His saying «وما للظالمين مِن أنصار»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما للظالمين»: «ما» is negating, the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, «أنصار» is mubtadaʾ, and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); and the clause is conjoined to the clause «مأواه النار».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: (وما من إله إلا إله واحد) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive, «ما» is negating, «إلهٍ» is mubtadaʾ (subject), «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «إلهٌ» is a badal (substitute) of the position of «إله», i.e.: there is no god deserving of worship except a God characterised by oneness; and the clause is resumptive. The clause «لَيَمَسَّنَّ» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the answer to the oath indicating it; the oath is understood as placed first, and had it been intended to come later in the implied construction, the condition would have been answered; the implied form is: «لئن لم».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «أفلا»: the hamza is for the interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and «لا» is negating.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: (ما المسيح ابن مريم إلا رسول) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «ما» is negating, without governing effect (muhmala), and [«المسيح» is] mubtadaʾ (subject); «ابن» is a naʿt (adjective); «رسول» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the clause «قد خَلَت» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «رسول»; and the clause «أُمُّه صِدِّيقةٌ» is conjoined to «المسيح رسول». His saying «انظُر كيف نبيِّن»: [«كيف» is] an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «نبيِّن» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, in the position of the accusative. His saying «أنَّى يُؤفَكون»: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl, and the clause «يؤفكون» is the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, suspended by the interrogative, [the verb] carrying the meaning of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما», and the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to a ḥāl of «ضرًا», the object.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «غيرَ الحقِّ»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: do not exaggerate an exaggeration other than the truth. The clause «قد ضَلُّوا» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «مِن بَنِي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الذين», and the preposition and its genitive noun «على لسان» is attached to «لُعِنَ». «ما» in His saying «بما عَصَوا» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate); the clause «عَصَوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: His saying «لَبِئسَ ما كانوا»: the lām occurs in the reply to an implied oath; «بئس» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for blame; «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent); and the one specified [for blame] is omitted, i.e.: their conduct in abandoning forbidding [wrong].

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: (لبئس ما قدمت لهم أنفسهم أن سخط الله عليهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The lām occurs in the reply to an implied oath, and [«بئس» is] an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for blame; «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent); «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هو», and that is the one specified for blame; the implied form is: it is Allah's displeasure. The clause «هو أن سخط» explains the verb of blame. The clause «هم خالدون» is conjoined to «سَخِط», the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, because it is within the scope of the one specified for blame; the implied form is: evil is what their souls have sent ahead — it is what brings about Allah's displeasure, and they will abide in the punishment.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «ما اتَّخَذُوهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «ولكنَّ كثيرًا منهم فاسقون» is conjoined to the clause «كانوا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «عداوةً» is tamyīz (specification), and the preposition and its genitive noun «لِلذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عداوة»; «اليهود» is the second object of «تَجِدَنَّ», and His saying «الذين قالوا» is the second object of the second «تَجِدَنَّ». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنَّ منهم» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (predicate), and the clause «ذلك بأنَّ منهم» is resumptive; the maṣdar «وأنَّهم لا يَستكبِرون» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar, in the position of the genitive; the implied form is: that is because of there being priests among them, and their not being arrogant.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The conditional clause «وإذا سمعوا.. ترى» is conjoined to the clause «لا يَستكبِرون», in the position of the nominative, and the clause «تَفيضُ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أعينَهم», in the position of the accusative. The preposition and its genitive noun «مِن الدَّمع» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تَفيضُ», «مِن» being explicative (bayāniyya), and the preposition and its genitive noun «مما عرفوا» is attached to «تفيض», «مِن» being for cause; two identical particles may thus be attached to one governing word because their meanings differ. The preposition and its genitive noun «من الحق» is attached to a ḥāl of the object of «عَرَفُوا». The clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl of the genitive pronoun in «أعينهم».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «وما لنا لا نؤمن» is conjoined to the preceding reply to the vocative. «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); and the clause «لا نؤمن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun «نا». The preposition and its genitive noun «من الحق» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «جاء», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يدخلنا» is accusative by removal of the preposition («في»). The clause «ونَطمَعُ» is conjoined to the clause «لا نؤمن», with its negation understood, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «أولئك أصحابُ الجَحيمِ» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «حَلالا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); originally it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e.: lawful food.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «ولكنْ يُؤاخذُكم» is conjoined to the clause «لا يؤاخذكم», with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun «مِن أَوسَط» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted object; the implied form is: sustenance being of the average. His saying «فصيامُ»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: its expiation is fasting; and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). His saying «إذا حَلَفْتُمْ»: a pure adverb attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كفارة», and the clause «حلفتم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His saying «كذلك»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied form is: Allah makes clear a making-clear like that making-clear; and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «يُبَيِّنُ» is resumptive, and the clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «فاجتنبوه» is conjoined to the reply to the vocative, «إنما الخمر رجس» and what follows it, and the clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The clause «فهل أنتم منتهون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The clause «فإنْ تَوليتم» is conjoined to the clause «احذروا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «فيما طَعِمُوا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «جناح». His saying «إذا ما»: an adverbial conditional, attached to the implied apodosis: they incur no sin; and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «تَنَالُه أيديكم» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «لِيعلَم الله» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يَبلُوَنَّكم». The preposition and its genitive noun «بالغَيب» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يخاف», and the clause «فمن اعتدى» is conjoined to the reply to the vocative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The clause «وأنتم حُرُمٌ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «ومَن قَتَله» is conjoined to the reply to the vocative; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «قَتَل», and «متعمِّدًا» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «قَتَلَهُ». His saying «فجزاءٌ»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is implied, i.e.: then upon him; the clause «فعليه جزاء» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «مِثْلُ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جزاء»; «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun «مِن النَّعَمِ» is attached to a ḥāl of «ما»; and the clause «يَحْكُمُ بِهِ ذَوَا» is a naʿt of «جزاء». His saying «هَدْيا»: a ḥāl of the pronoun in «به»; «بالغَ» is a naʿt of «هديًا», and this annexation is verbal (lafẓiyya): it yields lightening by dropping the tanwīn and does not yield definiteness, which is why an indefinite noun may be qualified by it. His saying «أو كَفَّارَةٌ»: conjoined to «جزاء»; «طعامٌ» is a badal (substitute) of «كفارة»; His saying «عدل» is conjoined to «كفَّارَةٌ»; «صيامًا» is tamyīz (specification); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليذُوقَ» is genitive, attached to something implied, i.e.: he has been requited with that so that he may taste; the clause «فينتقمُ» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هو»; and the clause «فهو ينتقم» is the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: His saying «وطعامُه»: conjoined to «صَيدُ». «متاعًا»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: He has given you enjoyment of it as an enjoyment, the maṣdar (verbal noun) being «تمتيعًا»; and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «متاعًا». His saying «ما دمتم»: «ما» is temporal maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is accusative as an adverb, attached to «حُرِّمَ»; the clause «دمتم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The two objects of «جعل» are «الكعبة» and «قيامًا», and «البيتَ الحرامَ» is a badal (substitute) and its naʿt (adjective). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتعلموا» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The maṣdar «أنَّ الَله يَعلمُ» stands in place of the two objects of «عَلِمَ», and the maṣdar «وأنَّ الله بكلِ شيءٍ عليمٌ» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «على الرسول» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), «البلاغُ» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «واللهُ يَعلمُ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: His saying «ولو أعجبك»: the wāw is ḥāliyya, conjoining to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied form is: they are not equal in any state, even in this state; this is for exhausting all states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: it would not be equal to the good; and the clause is a ḥāl, in the position of the accusative. The clause «يا أولي الألباب» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «لعلكم تفلحون».

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: The conditional clause «إنْ تُبْدَ لكم تَسُؤْكم» is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of «أشياءَ», and the clause «عفا الله» is in the position of the genitive as a second adjective of «أشياء».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The clause «قد سألها» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: His saying «من بَحِيرَةٍ»: «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and «بَحِيرَةٍ» is the first object; the second object of «جعل» is omitted, i.e.: legislated. The clause «ولكن الذين كفروا» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «ما جعل», and the clause «وأكثرُهم لا يعقلونَ» is conjoined to the clause «يَفْتَرُونَ».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a pronoun referring back to its maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل». His saying «تعالَوا»: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). His saying «حسبنا ما وجدنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). His saying «أَوَلَوْ كان»: the hamza is for the interrogative, and the wāw is ḥāliyya, conjoining to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial); the meaning is disapproval of their following their fathers in every state, even in the state of their being marked by lack of knowledge and guidance. The apodosis of «لو» is omitted, its implied form being: they would follow them; and the clause «أولو كان آباؤهم» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: His saying «عليكم أنفسكم»: [«عليكم» is] an imperative verbal noun (ism fiʿl amr) meaning "keep to"; «أنفسكم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause «لا يضركم» is resumptive. His saying «إذا اهتديتم»: an adverbial conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) indicated by what precedes «إذا», and the clause «اهتديتم» is in the position of the genitive by annexation. The clause «إلى الله مرجعكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «فينبئكم» is conjoined to the clause «إلى الله مرجعكم».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «إذا حضر»: a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «شهادة». His saying «حين الوصية»: an adverb, a badal (substitute) of «إذا»; «اثنان» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «شهادة», the implied form being: those bearing the testimony are two. His saying «ذوا»: an adjective (ṣifa), nominative by the alif because it is dual; and the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to an adjective of «اثنان». His saying «إن أنتم»: [«أنتم» is] the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by what follows; the clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: then call two others as witnesses; the clause «ضربتم» is explicative, and the clause «تحبسونهما» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «إن ارتبتم» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: then make them both swear. The clause «لا نشتري به» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. His saying «ولو كان»: the wāw is ḥāliyya, conjoining to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: we will not sell it for a price in any state, even in this state; this is for exhausting all states; the apodosis of «لو» is omitted, and the clause is a ḥāl. The clause «ولا نكتم شهادة الله» is conjoined to the clause «لا نشتري», with no grammatical position. The clause «إنا إذًا لمن الآثمين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «على أنهما استحقا» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). His saying «فآخران»: khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: then the two witnesses are two others; and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive. The clause «يقومان» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «آخران», and His saying «مقامَهما» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition and its genitive noun «من الذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يقومان», and «الأوليان» is the fāʿil of «استحق». The clause «لشهادتنا أحق» is the answer to the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun «من شهادتهما» is attached to «أحق». The clause «وما اعتدينا» is conjoined to the answer to the oath, and the clause «إنا لمن الظالمين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يأتوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition «إلى». The preposition and its genitive noun «على وجهها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الشهادة». The maṣdar «أن ترد» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The adverb «بعد أيمانهم» is attached to «تُرَدّ».

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «يوم يجمع»: the object of an omitted verb, its implied form being «احذروا» (beware), and the clause «يجمع» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His saying «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, khabar (predicate); the clause «قالوا» is resumptive. His saying «أنت»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of «إن». «الغيب» is made plural [Translator's note: in «الغيوب»], even though it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), because of the diversity of its kinds.

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: «إذ قال»: an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of a concealed «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «عليك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نعمتي». His saying «إذ أيدتك»: a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «نعمتي». The clause «تكلم» is a ḥāl of the kāf in «أيدتك», and the preposition and its genitive noun «في المهد» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «تكلم». His saying «وكهلا»: a noun conjoined to the preceding ḥāl, i.e.: being in the cradle and in maturity. His saying «وإذ علمتك»: conjoined to the preceding «إذ», and likewise «وإذ تخلق». The kāf in «كهيئة» is a noun meaning «مثل» (like), mafʿūl bihi, and «هيئة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذني» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «تخلق». His saying «فتكون طيرًا بإذني»: the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «طيرًا». «إذ» in His saying «وإذ تخرج»: an adverbial noun conjoined to the «إذ» before it, and the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذني» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «تخرج». «إذ» in His saying «إذ جئتهم»: an adverb of time attached to «كففت». «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هذا سحر» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: (وإذ أوحيت إلى الحواريين أن آمنوا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is the object of an implied «اذكر» (remember); «أن» is explicative (mufassira), and the clause «آمنوا» is explicative. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأننا مسلمون» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اشهد».

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: His saying «إذ قال»: the object of a concealed «اذكر» (remember), and the preposition and its genitive noun «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مائدة». The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نأكل» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His saying «أن قد صدقتنا»: «أن» is lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar, which stands in place of the two objects; and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أن».

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: «اللهم ربنا»: [«اللهم» is] the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the mīm is a substitute for «يا». His saying «ربنا»: a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name. The clause «تكون» is a naʿt of «مائدة». His saying «لأولنا»: a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal (substitute) of «لنا». His saying «وآية منك»: a noun conjoined to «عيدًا», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «آية». The clause «وارزقنا» is conjoined to the clause «أنزل». The clause «وأنت خير الرازقين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: The clause «فمن يكفر» is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. His saying «عذابًا»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being «تعذيبًا». The clause «لا أعذبه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عذابًا». The hāʾ in «لا أعذبه» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is the pronoun of the maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: (وإذ قال الله يا عيسى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «إذ» is the object of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «إلهين». His saying «سبحانك»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أقول» is the noun of «كان». The clause «إن كنت قلته» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «تعلَم ما في نفسي» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf in «إنك».

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: «ما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «قلت». «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is a badal (substitute) of the hāʾ in «به», and «ربي» is a badal of the Divine Name. «ما» in «ما دمت» is temporal maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهيدًا». The clause «فلما توفَّيتني» is conjoined to the clause «كنت عليهم», and the clause «وأنت على كل شيء شهيد» is conjoined to the clause «وكنت عليهم شهيدًا».

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: «هذا يوم» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause «ينفع» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» and the adverb «أبدًا» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين». The clause «رضي الله عنهم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: His saying «وما فيهن»: a relative noun conjoined to «السماوات», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); and the clause «وهو قدير» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «لله ملك», with no grammatical position.
